d: Jazz² Resurrection is reimplementation of the game Jazz Jackrabbit 2 released in 1998.
ld:
Jazz² Resurrection is reimplementation of the game Jazz Jackrabbit 2 released in 1998. Supports various versions of the game (Shareware Demo, Holiday Hare '98, The Secret Files and Christmas Chronicles). Also, it partially supports some features of JJ2+ extension and MLLE.

- PsVitaAlive -
req:
- Extract libshacccg.suprx from the console firmware to ur0:/data/, shaders are compiled on the console
- Copy contents of original Jazz Jackrabbit 2 directory to ux0:/data/jazz2/Source/
